description: This file defines the ProjectActivityDecorator class, which provides a decorator pattern implementation for the ProjectActivity entity in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for setting the project associated with a ProjectActivity instance via its ID.
external_methods: getReference (from ORM or EntityManager class, used internally in setProjectById)

classes.name: ProjectActivityDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for ProjectActivity entity, providing additional methods such as associating a project by its ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a ProjectActivity instance.

methods.name: setProjectById
methods.description: Associates a Project entity with the current ProjectActivity based on the provided project ID.
